mapper.sql: SELECT observation_users.user_id FROM JSON_TABLE( t.envelope_json, '$.observations[*]' COLUMNS ( user_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.userId' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR ) ) AS observation_users WHERE observation_users.user_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(observation_users.user_id) != '' LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT extracted.user_id, MAX(a.nickname) AS nickname, MAX(a.username) AS username, MAX(a.email) AS email, COUNT(*) AS conversation_count, MAX(extracted.processed_at) AS last_processed_at FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT t.id, t.processed_at, observation_users.user_id FROM langfuse_session_tracing t JOIN JSON_TABLE( t.envelope_json, '$.observations[*]' COLUMNS ( user_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.userId' NULL ON EMPTY NULL ON ERROR ) ) AS observation_users WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.enabled = 1 AND observation_users.user_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(observation_users.user_id) != '' ) extracted LEFT JOIN account a ON CAST(a.id AS CHAR) = extracted.user_id AND a.enabled = 1 GROUP BY extracted.user_id ORDER BY last_processed_at DESC, extracted.user_id ASC

SELECT CAST(detail_row.id AS CHAR) AS id, detail_row.session_id, detail_row.project_id, detail_row.user_id, a.nickname, a.username, a.email, detail_row.status, detail_row.llm_analysis_json, detail_row.trace_count, detail_row.seed_observation_count, detail_row.full_observation_count, detail_row.score_count, detail_row.qa_pair_count, detail_row.type_counts_json, detail_row.warnings_json, detail_row.first_observation_start_time, detail_row.last_observation_end_time, detail_row.processed_at FROM ( SELECT t.*, () AS user_id FROM langfuse_session_tracing t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.id = #{id} AND t.enabled = 1 ) detail_row LEFT JOIN account a ON CAST(a.id AS CHAR) = detail_row.user_id AND a.enabled = 1
SELECT t.llm_analysis_json, t.qa_pairs_json, t.conversation_json, t.envelope_json, t.warnings_json FROM langfuse_session_tracing t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.id = #{id} AND t.enabled = 1
SELECT t.status, COUNT(*) AS status_count FROM langfuse_session_tracing t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.enabled = 1 GROUP BY t.status
SELECT c.status, COUNT(*) AS status_count FROM langfuse_session_trace_cursor c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.enabled = 1 GROUP BY c.status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM langfuse_session_trace_cursor c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.enabled = 1 AND c.status = 'PROCESSING' AND c.leased_until < NOW(3)
SELECT MAX(t.processed_at) FROM langfuse_session_tracing t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.enabled = 1
